prompt: A React UI uses its documented design-system style prop and a server-backed form with an editable local draft. A token change intentionally alters spacing; one axe check passes. Review the affected state, rendering and accessibility risks without imposing a new bundler, store or test framework.

criteria.description: Distinguishes an intentional editable draft and accepted styling API from unsafe redundant state or a universal inline-style ban.
Requests meaningful affected visual/interaction/focus evidence without claiming that a passing automated accessibility check proves conformance or legal compliance.
Does not guarantee children never render, require zero pixel tolerance or treat a token change as automatically blocking under an invented policy.
